notes.content: The lesson that stayed with me is the one that's easy to skip right past — he may need to rebuild his strength first. Because when somebody wants to come back to Jehovah, the instinct, theirs and ours both, is that coming back has to mean everything at once. Full meeting schedule, back in the ministry, all caught up by Sunday. And this part says the opposite. Rebuild strength first. Resume gradually. Think about what that tells us about how Jehovah sees a returning one. Isaiah 40:29 says he "gives power to the tired one" — not a demand that the tired one already be strong before he's welcome back. Power to the tired one. The strength was never the entry requirement. The strength is the gift he gives you after you start walking back. So the lesson isn't only for someone who left. It's for how I treat someone coming back. I don't hand them my whole schedule and call that help. I hand them one prayer, one verse, one meeting — and let Jehovah do the rebuilding.
